I'm Dr. David Geier — triple-board certified orthopedic surgeon, sports medicine specialist, and anti-aging & regenerative medicine expert.

I want to help you recover from injuries and get back to the active life you love, regardless of age. My approach focuses on healing without surgery whenever possible — because it's not just about the injury. It's about getting you back to your sport, your workouts, and the people you love.

I'm the author of the Active Life Orthopedics Guides — practical books on recovering from the most common orthopedic injuries and conditions, written for athletes and active people like you. New titles throughout 2026.
📚 Get the books: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GF8ZQZTX
